Start with an education that covers business fundamentals, business practices, and business skills—an education offered in the Bachelor of Science in Business Administration (BSBA) at Post University.

From teambuilding to problem-solving, this BSBA degree program offers learning experiences designed to help students develop and hone a working knowledge of the basic business disciplines of accounting, economics, management, finance, marketing, business law, and supply chain management. Guided by the modern business landscape, this program offers a current perspective on areas such as global business, ethics in business, and decision making-particularly as it relates to times of uncertainty. A capstone course wraps up the education, providing the opportunity to apply what students have learned in their coursework to real-world business scenarios.

The Bachelor of Science in Computer Information Systems at Post University offers students:

  • Industry-Relevant Curriculum: Post University’s Bachelor of Science in Computer Information Systems offers a curriculum designed to align with the current demands and trends in the IT industry. Courses cover a wide range of topics, including programming, database management, cybersecurity, web development, and systems analysis to help provide students with a comprehensive understanding of the field.
  • Learning Flexibility: The program offers flexible learning options, including online courses and part-time study, to give students the opportunity to balance their educations with work and other commitments. This flexibility gives working professionals and non-traditional students greater freedom to pursue their CIS degrees without disrupting their lives.
  • Hands-On Learning: Students will be given opportunities to apply theoretical knowledge in practical, hands-on projects and assignments. Through labs, projects, and internships, students are able to gain valuable real-world experience while enhancing their skills to prepare for the workforce.
  • Industry Connections: Post University maintains strong connections with industry partners to give students opportunities for networking, internships, and potential employment upon graduation. These connections offer valuable insights into the industry and could help students build their professional networks.
  • Supportive Community: The Bachelor of Science in Computer Information Systems program at Post University provides a supportive learning environment with small class sizes and personalized attention from faculty and staff. Students have access to academic advising, tutoring services, and career counseling for the support they could use to succeed academically and professionally.
  • Versatility: Computer Information Systems, as a field, is applied in a number of industries, including technology, finance, healthcare, education, research, and more. The skills and insights offered in this program could help graduates pursue opportunities in various fields involving innovation and even entrepreneurship.

To make strategic decisions, organizational leaders require the best information available. They rely on professionals with business intelligence (BI) and data analytics skills to help them understand the data and help improve business operations. Students who have a desire to pursue a strategic support position or leadership role for your organization, consider pursuing a master’s in business intelligence and analytics from Post University. This STEM-designated degree program offers learning experiences students could use to identify opportunities for improving processes, operations, and more.

Coursework for the business intelligence and data analytics graduate program explores data analytics and management, business performance and customer relationship management, decision support and intelligent systems, and more. In the Master of Science in Business Intelligence and Analytics program, the curriculum is designed to provide learning opportunities for developing a skill set on how to assess an organization’s business, use data, and help it grow through strategic decision-making based on that data. This science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM) master’s degree also covers how to efficiently and effectively collect data, clean and filter raw data, and use that knowledge to make appropriate strategic decisions.

This accredited MBA program uses project-based learning—an educational approach featuring real-world projects—to give students the opportunity to apply theoretical knowledge to practical situations for hands-on experience in solving complex business problems. It is designed to help students develop the critical thinking, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills used in the business world. The curriculum also offers the learning opportunities students could use to refine skills for creativity, innovation, ethics, and quantitative reasoning.

Core coursework for the online Master of Business Administration degree covers what it takes to strengthen understanding of key areas of business, from organizational management to strategic planning. From there, students will customize their MBA to their goals with selection of one of 13 concentrations, including two STEM-designated MBA concentrations. Students choose from Financial Analytics (STEM), Business Intelligence and Analytics (STEM), Corporate Innovation, Entrepreneurship, Finance, Healthcare Systems Leadership, Human Resource Management, Leadership, Marketing, Multidisciplinary, Project Management, Small and Medium Business Enterprise, or Supply Chain Management.
